description: Pinned MIT reference for native Collapse contracts, lifecycle and slots. This record does not promote upstream compatibility.
adaptations: Native View wrappers replace DOM elements; an absolute measured wrapper preserves natural dimensions while clipped and returns to normal flow when entered. There is one retained content tree.
Reuse the existing transition lifecycle, reduced-motion preference and public native refs. Layout animation uses Animated dimensions with a JavaScript driver.
Resolve defaults, named slot styles, sx, refs and utility identifiers through the native theme system. DOM elements, CSS selectors and HTMLElement mutation require native equivalents.
